calculation_meaning.inputs: same-symbol spot and USD-M perpetual trade OHLC plus mark OHLC on identical complete hourly grids; bar t available at t+1h-1ms; no imputation; native funding timestamps, rates, intervals and settlement mark prices required
calculation_meaning.signal: basis=perp trade close/spot close-1; enter when basis >= entry_basis; exit when basis <= exit_basis; otherwise keep state; {"capital_fraction":0.25,"entry_basis":0.001,"exit_basis":0.0005}
calculation_meaning.execution: one pre-start signal bar; previous closed-hour signal executes at next hour open on both trade-price series; funding at the exact open timestamp settles on the old position before trading; later events settle on the new position; end marked at spot close and perp mark close, no forced closing; fees/slippage on both legs; margin checked before trading at mark open and conservatively at hourly mark high without crediting positive intrahour funding; guard breach stops with partial ledger, not an invented liquidation fill
calculation_meaning.position: long spot and equal base quantity short linear USDT perpetual; quantities fixed until close; spot entry notional=capital_fraction*equity; reserve 100% of perp entry notional as cash collateral; short notional is never credited as sale proceeds; no leverage, borrowing or collateral top-ups; margin guard ratio=0.1 of current short mark notional; this is not historical exchange margin tiers
calculation_meaning.costs: same fee_bps and slippage_bps charged separately on each leg; stress multiplies both by stress_multiplier; funding cashflow for short=quantity*event mark price*rate; funding is never multiplied by fee stress; {"fee_bps":10.0,"initial_capital":10000.0,"min_trade_fraction":0,"slippage_bps":5.0,"stress_multiplier":2.0}
calculation_meaning.parameters: symbol and margin guard fixed by contract; only {"capital_fraction":0.25,"entry_basis":0.001,"exit_basis":0.0005} are model choices
